collection.description: A child asks why fish do not seem to notice that they are wet.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) asks why fish do not seem to notice that they are wet.

choices.label: Explain How Fish Live in Water.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (child) watches fish near shore and asks another question.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) decides that people may not notice the air around them either.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (adult) jokes that fish probably complain when they are dry.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) laughs, then asks for the serious explanation.
